messageEn: System roles cannot be changed or deleted.
messageSw: Majukumu ya mfumo hayawezi kubadilishwa au kufutwa.

messageEn: This role is assigned to one or more users and cannot be deleted.
messageSw: Jukumu hili limepewa mtumiaji mmoja au zaidi na haliwezi kufutwa.

messageEn: You cannot remove your own administrator role.
messageSw: Huwezi kujiondolea jukumu lako la usimamizi.
